title: U.S. House · Texas's 29th Congressional District
area: East Houston, including parts of the Houston Ship Channel area.

context.text: Texas redrew its congressional district boundaries in August 2025 ahead of the 2026 elections, a mid-decade redistricting.
In the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary, incumbent Sylvia Garcia defeated Jarvis Johnson and Robert Slater, 58.2% to 35.7% to 6.1%. Martha Fierro was unopposed for the Republican nomination.

summary.text: Sylvia Garcia is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for Texas's 29th District, a former Texas state senator, Houston city controller, and municipal court judge.

background.text: Born in San Diego, Texas, in 1950; earned a bachelor's degree in social work and political science from Texas Woman's University in 1972 and a J.D. from Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University in 1978.

Worked as a social worker and legal aid lawyer; served as presiding judge of the Houston Municipal Court system, Houston city controller, a Harris County commissioner, and in the Texas Senate from 2013 to 2018.

positions.summary: Campaign issues page says she is fighting to pass the Women's Health Protection Act to safeguard access to safe, legal abortion.
positions.quote: she is fighting to pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to safeguard access to safe, legal healthcare, abortion, and IVF

positions.summary: Official site says she supports gun safety legislation and is a member of the Gun Violence Prevention Task Force.
positions.quote: Congresswoman Garcia supports gun safety legislation

positions.summary: Campaign issues page says she is pushing back against cuts to Medicaid and Medicare.
positions.quote: She is pushing back against Trump and his billionaire allies who put corporate profits ahead of people, slashing Medicaid, Medicare, and programs that help families make ends meet.

record.text: Serves on the House Committee on Financial Services and the House Committee on Ethics in the 119th Congress.

candidates.name: Martha Fierro
candidates.ballotNote: Unopposed for the Republican nomination in the March 3, 2026 primary

summary.text: Martha Fierro is a repeat Republican candidate in the Houston area who has run for the Texas House and Texas Senate in prior cycles and was unopposed for the 2026 Republican nomination in this district.
